<p align="center"><strong>The garden gate is open. Nobody gets left behind.</strong></p>


<p align="center">The leaf bell rings. The latch lifts, and you follow the garden stairs with your cat balanced proudly on your shoulder.</p>

<p align="center">The path home is clear. The ghost waves a warm cup in your direction, just in case.</p>

<p align="center">A trail of unlit lanterns leads away from the gate, toward a greenhouse. On the nearest post hangs a note: &quot;If you have a little longer, the house could use your help.&quot;</p>
